{{Top}}
'''Cybernetic hibernation''' was a form of [[Suspended animation/Legends|suspended animation]] that was used in the [[Time/Legends|time]] before the invention of the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]. Space travelers used cybernetic hibernation for intra-[[Star system/Legends|system]] travel to avoid spending [[Standard year/Legends|years]] or [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] in transit between [[Planet/Legends|planets]]. The use of cybernetic hibernation ended once hyperdrive technology had become commonplace.<ref name="SWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]'', published in [[1987]], the term was spelt as "cybernetic hybernation." With the [[The Star Wars Sourcebook (Second Edition)|reprinting]] of the material in [[1994]] to update the roleplaying game stats for the Second Edition, the spelling was revised to "cybernetic hibernation."
